key_idea: The two pieces fit together along the slanted cut to make the rectangle.
steps: The orange piece is narrow at the top and wide at the bottom. Its slanted side is on the right.
The other piece fills the rest of the rectangle, to the right of the orange piece.
So the other piece is wide at the top and narrow at the bottom. Its slanted side is on the left, to fit the orange piece.
Its right side is straight, because it is the side of the rectangle. That is piece C.

choice_feedback.A: This piece is a square with no slanted side, so it cannot fit the cut.
choice_feedback.B: This piece has its slanted side on the right, so it does not sit against the orange piece's slanted side.
choice_feedback.D: This is a triangle. It cannot fill the space next to the orange piece.
choice_feedback.E: This piece has a step instead of a slanted side.

review.note: Option B is the mirror image of C. A paper piece flipped over would look like B, so a child may think B also fits. C is the piece exactly as it sits in the rectangle.
